constraints_found.constraint: Craving: sushi (cold food, too hot for anything warm)
constraints_found.line: SUSHI. way too hot out for anything warm. let's do it!!
sushi yes. fancy sushi no. one dollar sign max, the trip fund is non-negotiable
One rule, for anyone new: I'm allergic to peanuts. Some rolls come with peanut sauce or crushed peanuts on top, so please check.

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian, needs real veggie rolls / a meat-free section (strict diet, deal-breaker)
constraints_found.line: and mina's vegetarian, so we need a place with real veggie rolls. not one lonely cucumber roll at the bottom of the menu

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance, nothing creamy / no cream cheese (costs one star)
constraints_found.line: ok i'm so ready. oh, small thing, nothing creamy in mine pls. dairy and i don't get along

venue_analysis.downtown_koi_counter: $, sushi, whole meat-free section, no peanuts, no dairy. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_analysis.downtown_kumo_bar: Crushed peanuts and peanut sauce on everything: deal-breaker for Cyrus.
venue_analysis.downtown_silver_reed: Fish in every roll, fish-stock miso: deal-breaker for vegetarian Mina.
venue_analysis.downtown_hinoki_table: Cream cheese on nearly everything: Roxy's intolerance, 2 stars.

notes: Clean, fair puzzle. Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and the reviews are explicit. Hinoki Table and Cedar Line are good 2-star traps. Mina's diet arrives via Maya rather than Mina herself, which makes it a little less obvious, but it is clearly stated. Cyrus's cream cheese line reinforces Roxy's dairy note, so the clue is easy to catch. Nothing unfair or contradictory. Possibly slightly easy for level 8.
